title: Referral program routes
description: The routes of Settings › Referral program (decision 0021 S1; docs/referral-program.md): this gcx's one partner code, and a partner's own key. A signed-in person's only, never an access key's (the partner key is a secret). All are additions to /api/v1; a runtime with no partner signing key built in answers 404. Percentages are decimal strings.

join.description: POST /api/v1/referral: a partner's code, as pasted (whitespace around it is trimmed). Verified offline against our key; stored once, never changed or removed. 422 {error: "Invalid code"} or {error: "You can't refer yourself"} (this gcx's own partner key has the code's partner number); 409 {error: "You're already referred"}. Internal startup tier accepts the exact typed text into separate test metadata, without verification or server effects.

install.description: POST /api/v1/partner: a partner key, as pasted. Valid when every code in it verifies against our key; it replaces the one stored. 422 {error: "Invalid key"}. Internal startup tier accepts the exact typed text as a separate local sample key, without verification or server effects.

referral.description: GET /api/v1/referral, and the answer of POST: the code this gcx joined with and what it changes. Without a code: code null, discount "0", fee "0.03", since null.

code.description: The code's text (gcx- and 99 characters); null before one is entered.

discount.description: The discount on gcx's fee the code gives, a percent of the fee.

fee.description: gcx's builder fee on every order from the next one on, a percent of the trade (0.03 without a code, 0.027 with a 10 % code).

since.description: When the code was entered (Unix ms); null before.

test.description: True only for an internal local test overlay; no effect on actual fees. Absent on older builds.

partner.description: GET /api/v1/partner, and the answer of POST: this gcx's partner key, or {key: null} when none is installed.

max.description: His maximum share, a percent of gcx's fee.

valid.description: False when the key was made under a signing key this version no longer trusts (a rotation): no code is shown; ask goodcryptoX for a new key.

codes.description: One code per discount from 0 to the maximum in 10 % steps; empty when not valid.

key.description: The partner key's text, for Copy partner key.

test.description: Internal local sample key only; never a verified server key.

figures.description: GET /api/v1/partner/figures (decision 0021 amendment 4 d6): per code of the stored partner key, read from goodcryptoX's partner-code server, at most once a minute and only when the page asks. 404 with no key that verifies, the internal test key, no server, or a server that does not serve figures yet; 503 {error} when the server cannot be read and nothing is kept. Counts and sums only: nothing names an installation, an address or an account.

through.description: The last UTC day the volume is counted through (ruling 108 (a)); null before any day is counted.

at.description: When the server's answer was received (Unix ms).

stale.description: True when the server could not be read now and the last answer received is served.

codes.description: One entry per discount from 0 to the key's maximum, in order.

discount.description: The code's discount, a percent of gcx's fee (as GET /api/v1/partner names it).

joined.description: Users who joined with this code.

trading.description: Of those, the ones whose orders reached the server this week (from Monday 00:00 UTC).

volume.description: This week's paid volume per unit, a day or two behind (the trades that pay, as goodcryptoX counts them to pay); empty when none. The main collateral first, then by name.

clear.description: C77: internal-only local test reset. No permanent referral, installation/report or fee record is rewritten.
